title: Crestline Fleet Account Remittance Speed Points on Early-Pay Discounts
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account, remittance speed points are added to the early-pay rate (the percent at which the early-pay discount is figured) of an invoice that earns the early-pay discount. They reward a remittance that arrives soon after the invoice date on an account with no recent late charge.

## Points

Remittance speed points are counted in calendar days from the invoice date to the date of the remittance:

| Days from the invoice date to the remittance | Late charge assessed on the account less than twelve whole months before today | Speed points |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or fewer (within 3 days) | none | 0.50 |
| 4 to 6 | none | 0.25 |
| 7 or more | none | none |
| any | one or more | none |

The remittance is the most recent remittance applied to the invoice. A late charge counts when the account's activity shows a late charge entry dated less than twelve whole months before today.

## Boundaries

- Day 3 earns 0.50; day 4 earns 0.25.
- Day 6 earns 0.25; day 7 earns none.
- A single late charge in the last twelve whole months removes the speed points entirely, however quickly the remittance arrived.

## Strength of the points

The points are percentage points: 0.50 points on a hypothetical early-pay rate of 1 percent make the rate 1.50 percent. On a program whose early-pay discount percent is 0, the invoice earns no discount, whatever is added to the early-pay rate.
